# Mini mPOS

> Free, open-source Android point of sale for Adyen terminals, tablets and phones.

This is the official merchant documentation. Choose the language below, then use Quick start for setup,
Using Mini mPOS for daily tasks, and Troubleshooting for recovery. The guides are the authoritative source
for device requirements, Adyen prerequisites and payment behavior. The setup helper creates encrypted QR
codes locally in the browser; it does not send credentials to a server.

## English

- [Mini mPOS guides](https://minimpos.app/)
- [Quick start](https://minimpos.app/quick-start)
- [Using Mini mPOS](https://minimpos.app/using)
- [Troubleshooting](https://minimpos.app/troubleshooting)
- [Setup helper](https://minimpos.app/setup)
